integrity.code_role: Independent finite corroboration, not an infinite proof.
integrity.normalized_orientation: The sparse letter is designated as 1; for N>=7 the count also equals the unrestricted extension count.
integrity.proof_basis: Exact incidence-graph contraction, coprime modular-cycle threshold, sparse matching extension, gcd-weighted summation and totient harmonic estimate.

scientific_limitations: The exact finite formula for N<7 counts forest-support-normalized extensions, not their letter-swapped counterparts.
The extension count is for prefixes containing exactly three ones; four or more ones are not treated.
The second-order remainder is O(N^2); its finer constant or periodicity is not determined.
Publication priority has not been independently certified.
title: A logarithmic correction in the enumeration of extendible three-one binary prefixes
